company_name.description: Company name used in legal text and emails.

support_email.description: Support contact address shown to users.

logo.description: Logo path, relative to the config directory. null shows the product name.

surfaces.description: Where each web surface is served.

account.description: Main account site and primary sign-in surface.

ports.description: Ports this surface answers on, for host-less setups.

base_path.description: Path prefix the surface is mounted under.

modules.description: Modules this surface owns. null uses the default ownership.

origins.description: Public origins browsers use for this surface, for CORS, the Origin check and feature discovery. null uses https://<host> for each host.

ports.description: Ports this surface answers on, for host-less setups.

base_path.description: Path prefix the surface is mounted under.

modules.description: Modules this surface owns. null uses the default ownership.

origins.description: Public origins browsers use for this surface, for CORS, the Origin check and feature discovery. null uses https://<host> for each host.

api.description: Non-browser clients: games, game servers and third-party apps.

ports.description: Ports this surface answers on, for host-less setups.

base_path.description: Path prefix the surface is mounted under.

modules.description: Modules this surface owns. null uses the default ownership.

origins.description: Public origins browsers use for this surface, for CORS, the Origin check and feature discovery. null uses https://<host> for each host.

name.description: Session cookie name. Gets the __Host- prefix when domain is null.

domain.description: Shared cookie domain. null uses host-only __Host- cookies.

session_ttl.description: Maximum session lifetime. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

idle_timeout.description: Session ends after this long without activity. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

allowed_origins.description: Extra credentialed CORS origins. Surface origins are added automatically.

trusted_proxies.description: Proxies whose forwarded client IP headers are trusted.

header.description: Request header holding the country code when source is header.

database_path.description: Country database file. DB-IP Lite CSV or gzipped CSV, or a MaxMind MMDB when source is maxmind.

lists_dir.description: Word-list directory, relative to the config file. Holds LDNOOBW, the dictionary, names, surnames, places, allow.txt and extra-block.txt.

ssl.description: TLS to Postgres. require encrypts without checking the certificate, verify-full also checks it.

idle_timeout.description: Close idle connections after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

connect_timeout.description: Give up connecting after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

roles.description: One role per service schema. Each role can only use its own schema.

identity.description: Credentials for the service that owns the identity schema.

user.description: Postgres role for the identity schema.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

notify.description: Credentials for the service that owns the notify schema.

user.description: Postgres role for the notify schema.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

oidc.description: Credentials for the service that owns the oidc schema.

user.description: Postgres role for the oidc schema.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

safety.description: Credentials for the service that owns the safety schema.

user.description: Postgres role for the safety schema.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

support.description: Credentials for the service that owns the support schema.

user.description: Postgres role for the support schema.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

games.description: Credentials for the service that owns the games schema.

user.description: Postgres role for the games schema.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

audit.description: Postgres role for the audit log. Identity grants it INSERT and SELECT only on identity.audit_log.

user.description: Postgres role for the audit log.

password.description: The role's password. Reference a secret.

auto_apply.description: Apply pending database migrations when a service starts.

user.description: NATS user. null connects without credentials.

password.description: The NATS user's password. Reference a secret.

required.description: Refuse to connect without TLS. TLS is used anyway when the server offers it.

ca_file.description: CA certificate file for verifying the server. null uses the system CAs.

connect_timeout.description: Give up connecting after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

request_timeout.description: Default deadline for request/reply calls between services. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

streams.description: JetStream streams, created or updated when a service starts.

replicas.description: JetStream replicas per stream. Use 3 on a NATS cluster.

events_max_age.description: Keep domain events in the stream for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

work_max_age.description: Drop cron ticks and work-queue jobs nobody took after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

duplicate_window.description: JetStream drops a message whose ID it has already seen within this window. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

poll_interval.description: Check the outbox for unsent events this often. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

sent_retention.description: Delete published events from the outbox after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

ack_wait.description: Redeliver a message if a consumer neither acks nor extends it. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max_deliver.description: Give up on a message after this many delivery attempts.

retry_delay.description: Delay before the first retry. Doubles with each attempt. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max_retry_delay.description: Longest delay between retries. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

dedupe_retention.description: Remember processed event IDs for this long. Must be at least streams.events_max_age. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

observability.description: Logs, traces, metrics and health checks.

logs.description: Structured JSON logs, written to standard output.

level.description: Lowest level written to the log.

user_id_hash_key.description: Key for hashing user IDs in logs. Use the same key on every service so logs can be joined. Reference a secret.

redact_keys.description: Extra field names whose values are never logged, on top of the built-in list (passwords, tokens, secrets, codes and the like).

enabled.description: Send traces to an OTLP collector. Trace IDs are still created, logged and passed between services when off.

sample_ratio.description: Share of traces to keep, from 0 to 1. Every service must use the same value.

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics, served on /metrics on the internal network.

process_metrics.description: Also report Node.js process metrics (CPU, memory, event loop, GC).

check_timeout.description: Count a /readyz dependency check as failed if it takes longer than this. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

port.description: Port each service listens on, on the internal network.

shutdown_timeout.description: On SIGTERM or SIGINT, wait this long for in-flight requests and background work before exiting anyway. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

identity_tokens.description: Internal identity tokens minted by the gateway (X-QTIAuth-Identity).

clock_tolerance.description: Allowed clock difference between the gateway and a service when checking internal identity token times. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

keys_refresh.description: Fetch the gateway's identity token public keys this often. Keys the service hasn't seen are fetched straight away. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

valkey.description: Valkey, for rate limits, the session cache and short-lived state.

user.description: Valkey ACL user. null uses the default user.

password.description: Valkey password. Empty connects without one. Reference a secret.

ca_file.description: CA certificate file for verifying the server. null uses the system CAs.

connect_timeout.description: Give up connecting after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

command_timeout.description: Treat Valkey as unavailable when a command takes longer than this. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

gateway.description: Gateway: the single public entry point.

port.description: Public port for surfaces bound to hosts. Surfaces bound to ports listen on their own ports.

max_body_size.description: Largest request body the gateway accepts, in bytes.

upstream_timeout.description: Give up on a service response after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

upstreams.description: Base URL per service. Services not listed are reached at http://<service>:<service.http.port>.

interval.description: Ask every service to announce itself this often. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

expiry.description: Forget a service instance that hasn't announced itself for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

startup_grace.description: After starting, wait this long for announcements before reporting services that aren't running. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

ttl.description: Keep a resolved session in Valkey for this long. Revocations and account changes clear it sooner. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

identity_keys.description: Signing keys for internal identity tokens (X-QTIAuth-Identity).

encryption_key.description: Base64 32-byte key that encrypts the signing keys at rest. Required to start the gateway. Reference a secret.

rotate_after.description: Replace the signing key once it is this old. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

retain_after_rotation.description: Keep publishing a replaced key for this long, so tokens it signed can still be checked. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

refresh.description: Reload signing keys from the store this often, so other gateway replicas pick up a rotation. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max_age.description: How long browsers remember to use HTTPS only. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

include_subdomains.description: Apply HSTS to every subdomain of each surface host too.

preload.description: Ask to be included in browser preload lists.

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret. Reference a secret.
OAuth client secret. Reference a secret.
OAuth client secret. Reference a secret.

id.description: Stable identifier used in URLs and linked accounts.

name.description: Name shown on the sign-in button.

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret. Reference a secret.

require_game_authority.description: Leaderboard scores need the game server's credential as well as the player's.

captcha.description: Bot protection. Shown after captcha.after attempts from an IP, then required.

provider.description: CAPTCHA provider. altcha is self-hosted proof-of-work. none disables CAPTCHA. The others verify with that vendor.

after.description: Show a CAPTCHA after this many failed password attempts from an IP, or this many signup or magic-link starts from an IP. 0 shows it on the first attempt.

window.description: Attempts older than this do not count towards the CAPTCHA threshold. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

hmac_key.description: HMAC key for Altcha challenges. Empty generates a key at startup; set it when running more than one identity replica.

max_number.description: Altcha proof-of-work upper bound. Higher is harder for the client.

expires.description: An Altcha challenge works for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

site_key.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key, public in the widget.

secret_key.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key. Reference a secret.

site_key.description: hCaptcha site key, public in the widget.

secret_key.description: hCaptcha secret key. Reference a secret.

site_key.description: Friendly Captcha site key, public in the widget.

secret_key.description: Friendly Captcha secret key. Reference a secret.

provider.description: Email delivery provider. console prints emails instead of sending them.

auth.description: Sender for sign-in and verification email.

default_locale.description: Locale used when an email's locale has no templates. Every template must exist in this locale.

templates_dir.description: Directory of template overrides, one subdirectory per locale, relative to the config directory. A file here replaces the built-in file of the same name.

security.description: starttls upgrades the connection and refuses servers that cannot, tls connects over TLS (usually port 465), none never uses TLS.

user.description: SMTP user. null sends without authenticating.

password.description: The SMTP user's password. Reference a secret.

connect_timeout.description: Give up connecting after this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

send_timeout.description: Give up on a send when the server goes quiet for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

queue.description: Outgoing email queue. With the defaults, an email is retried for about 6 hours before it fails.

max_attempts.description: Try sending an email this many times before marking it failed.

retry_delay.description: Delay before the first retry. Doubles with each attempt. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max_retry_delay.description: Longest delay between retries. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

step_up_window.description: Routes that need step-up accept a session that reached aal2 within this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

encryption_key.description: Base64 32-byte key that encrypts TOTP secrets at rest. Required when TOTP is enabled. Reference a secret.

require_2fa_for_permissions.description: Staff whose permissions match any of these must enrol a passkey or TOTP before using the rest of the product. Prefixes end in .* .

items.description: A permission or prefix that requires two-factor enrolment.

admin.name: Admin
admin.description: Full access, except permissions that must be granted by name.

moderator.name: Moderator
moderator.description: Moderate users, reports and the text filter.

roles.description: Staff roles, keyed by slug. Built-ins are seeded on startup and can then be edited with roles.manage. * never matches permissions that must be granted by name.

items.description: A permission, a prefix ending in .*, or *.

permissions.description: Permission grants this role confers. * does not include permissions that must be granted by name.

max_per_email.description: Accounts allowed per normalized email address.

email_normalization.description: Rules per email domain for deciding when two addresses are the same, on top of ignoring case. Setting this replaces the built-in rules.

remove_dots.description: Ignore dots in the local part, so j.doe@ and jdoe@ are the same address.

subaddress_separator.description: Ignore the local part from this character on, so with + jo+news@ and jo@ are the same address. null keeps the whole local part.

domain.description: Count addresses as belonging to this domain instead. null keeps the domain.

additionalProperties.description: How addresses at one domain are normalized.

email_change_ttl.description: The confirmation link sent to a new email address works for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

email_revert_ttl.description: The "this wasn't me" link sent to the previous email address works for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

deletion_grace.description: How long an account stays in pending_deletion after the user asks to delete it. Signing in during this time cancels the deletion. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

export_ttl.description: How long a data-export download link works. After this the zip is deleted. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

export_email_max_bytes.description: Largest export that can be emailed as an attachment when object storage is not configured. Larger exports need storage.

ttl.description: A magic link works for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

signup_ttl.description: After a new user opens their magic link, they have this long to enter their date of birth. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max_length.description: Longest a password can be. 256 is the hard cap.

composition.description: Optional composition rules. All off by default.

require_symbol.description: Require a character that is not a letter or digit.

breach_check.description: Reject passwords that appear in the Have I Been Pwned range API. Only the first 5 hex characters of a SHA-1 hash leave the server. Unreachable checks are skipped.

argon2.description: Argon2id parameters. Stored hashes are rehashed on login when these change.

memory_kib.description: Argon2id memory in KiB. OWASP default is 19456 (19 MiB).

reset_ttl.description: A password reset link works for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

verification_ttl.description: An email verification link after password signup works for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

failure_delay.description: Progressive delay after failed password attempts, counted per account and per IP. There is no lockout.

step.description: Extra delay added for each previous failed password attempt on the account or IP. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max.description: Longest progressive delay after failed password attempts. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

max_per_user.description: Sessions a user can have at once. Signing in again ends the oldest.

on_country_change.description: When a session moves to another country: challenge drops it to aal0 until the user signs in again, block ends it, notify allows it and emails, ignore does nothing.

new_device_email.description: Email the user when they sign in from a browser or OS that has not been seen.

tls_fingerprint.description: Optional TLS fingerprint from an upstream proxy.

header.description: Request header holding a TLS fingerprint such as JA4. null turns this signal off.

alert_min_interval.description: Shortest gap between security-alert emails to the same user. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

age.description: Age bands, computed from the date of birth, and age assurance.

bands.description: Age in whole years at which each band starts. Anyone younger is under_13.

adult.description: Age the adult band starts at.

default_provider.description: Provider used when a trigger in required_for applies. Only self_declared ships.

required_for.description: Triggers that need the default provider, such as claiming the adult band. Empty means a self-declared date of birth is enough.

consent_age.description: Users younger than this need a parent or guardian to approve their account.

charset.description: Allowed characters as a regex character class, e.g. [A-Za-z0-9_].

reserved.description: Usernames nobody can claim. Compared without regard to case. Empty by default.

reserved_prefixes.description: Username prefixes nobody can claim, such as a brand prefix. Compared without regard to case. Empty by default.

change_cooldown.description: How long a user must wait after claiming or changing a username before changing it again. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

changes_per_year.description: How many times a user can change their username inside change_window, after the first claim.

change_window.description: Window used to count username changes against changes_per_year. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

release_hold.description: How long a released username is held for the previous owner before anyone else can claim it. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

public_history.description: Previous versions are publicly viewable at /legal/<id>/<version>.

documents_dir.description: Markdown documents with YAML front-matter, relative to the config file. Identity syncs them into the database on startup.

rate_limits.description: Named rate-limit policies, referenced by routes. Policies you set replace the built-in policy of the same name.

per.description: What requests are counted by. A list counts each combination separately, e.g. [ip, account] counts each IP and account pair.

window.description: Sliding window length. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

on_store_failure.description: When Valkey is unreachable, let requests through (open) or refuse them (closed).

policies.description: Policies that all apply. A request is refused if any of them is exceeded.

scheduler.description: Scheduler: publishes cron ticks for the services that own each job.

timezone.description: Time zone the job schedules are written in.

jobs.description: Jobs published on qtiauth.sys.cron.<job>. Settings you give override the built-in job of the same name, and other built-in jobs stay as they are.

schedule.description: When the job runs, as a cron pattern: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week, with an optional seconds field first. Required for jobs that are not built in.

retention.description: How long data is kept. retention.sweep deletes anything older.

delivery_logs.description: Keep email delivery log entries for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

sessions.description: Keep sessions and their bindings for this long after they expire or are revoked. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

tokens.description: Keep magic-link and other emailed tokens for this long after they expire. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

session_security_events.description: Keep session security event log rows for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

filter_decisions.description: Keep text-filter decisions, including the raw input, for this long. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

audit.description: Keep audit log rows for this long. Oldest rows are removed first. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

enabled.description: Use S3-compatible object storage (the bundled MinIO or any external S3/R2/B2). Required for data exports above export_email_max_bytes, ticket attachments and cloud saves.

endpoint.description: S3 API base URL, such as http://minio:9000 or https://s3.amazonaws.com. Empty when storage is off.

bucket.description: Bucket for exports, attachments, cloud saves and the deletion ledger.

access_key.description: S3 access key. Empty when storage is off. Reference a secret.

secret_key.description: S3 secret key. Empty when storage is off. Reference a secret.

force_path_style.description: Path-style URLs (bucket in the path). Required for MinIO. Set false for AWS S3.

create_bucket.description: Create the bucket on startup if it does not exist. Turn off for Amazon S3.

ca_file.description: CA certificate file for verifying the server. null uses the system CAs.

presign_expires.description: How long a presigned upload or download URL works, other than data-export links which use accounts.export_ttl. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

backups.description: Encrypted backups and the deletion ledger destination.

destination.description: Where backups and the deletion ledger are written. directory is a mounted volume. storage is the S3 bucket. Restore replay is a later release.

directory.description: Directory for backups and the deletion ledger when destination is directory.

retention.description: How long backups are kept. The deletion ledger is kept this long plus 30 days. Written as <integer><unit> (ms, s, m, h, d, w).
